notes: Legislation list for the EUR-Lex/CELLAR connector. A case is selected when any instrument on this list is named in it. The hand-curated entries are the base instruments of Union pesticide law - plant protection products (79/117, 91/414, 1107/2009 and the approved-substance register 540/2011), residue limits (396/2005), biocides (98/8, 528/2012), sustainable use (2009/128) and statistics (1185/2009) - each with its bare number where that number is unambiguous, its bracketed and suffixed forms, and the short names courts use in English, French, German and Dutch. Every entry carrying 'derived_from' is an act CELLAR records as based on, amending or correcting one of those, enumerated by backend/scripts/legislation_from_cellar.py rather than typed, and cited by its number in the bracketed form every language of the Court uses. Revision 1.0.0: first legislation list, replacing keyword list 2.1.0 (core document 2.14).

terms.title: Council Directive 79/117/EEC of 21 December 1978 prohibiting the placing on the market and use of plant protection products containing certain active substances
terms.note: Repealed by Regulation (EC) No 1107/2009. Kept because historic litigation about banned substances cites it.

terms.title: Council Directive 91/414/EEC of 15 July 1991 concerning the placing of plant protection products on the market
terms.note: Predecessor of Regulation (EC) No 1107/2009; still cited in older and transitional cases. The bare number is carried, the one year/number number that is: a two-digit year is not a case-law reporter's citation form, and no other act of 1991 is cited as 91/414 in this corpus.

terms.title: Regulation (EC) No 1107/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 21 October 2009 concerning the placing of plant protection products on the market and repealing Council Directives 79/117/EEC and 91/414/EEC
terms.note: The central instrument. The bare number is the sharpest signal in every language.

terms.title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) No 540/2011 of 25 May 2011 implementing Regulation (EC) No 1107/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the list of approved active substances
terms.note: The register of approved active substances. Every approval, renewal and non-renewal regulation amends its Annex, so those acts are enumerated under it as well as under 1107/2009.

terms.title: Regulation (EC) No 396/2005 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 February 2005 on maximum residue levels of pesticides in or on food and feed of plant and animal origin and amending Council Directive 91/414/EEC
terms.note: Residue limits. In scope because a residue case is a pesticide case.

terms.title: Directive 98/8/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 16 February 1998 concerning the placing of biocidal products on the market
terms.note: Predecessor of Regulation (EU) No 528/2012. Its number is carried behind the type word only: 98/8 is too short to stand alone, and a suffixed 98/8/EC would also reach a decision of that number.

terms.title: Regulation (EU) No 528/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 22 May 2012 concerning the making available on the market and use of biocidal products
terms.note: Biocides are in scope: the Dutch statute governs plant protection products and biocides together.

terms.title: Directive 2009/128/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 21 October 2009 establishing a framework for Community action to achieve the sustainable use of pesticides
terms.note: Year/number is also how Dutch case-law reporters cite (NJ 2009/128), and a suffixed 2009/128/EC would also reach a decision of that number, so the number is carried behind the type word only.
